title: Spicy Egyptian Fish Tagine
description: A hearty German-inspired fish tagine with Egyptian spices and a spicy kick. Serve with a side of couscous or rice.

ingredients.name: Spicy Egyptian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Add the spicy Egyptian spice blend, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve hot, with a side of couscous or rice.
